messages:
maya: Quick run-through before tomorrow's UX review — focusing on the routing editor's preview controls, ordering affordances, and validation microcopy. keep it under 30m.

chris: For the preview, propose a 'compact playback' that shows rule evaluation as a horizontal carousel, not a modal. Keeps context with the editor. Thoughts?

sam: I like compact playback. Suggest we include a "ghosting" overlay to dim non-matching rules so the fired rule pops visually. cheaper than token streaming and clearer.

aleks: overlay good, but need to ensure contrast + non-color indicators. Maybe a left-border icon (bolt/check) for the matched rule plus a low-opacity outline for others.

leo: keyboard accessibility: carousel must be tabbable, arrow keys to navigate, and Enter to toggle expanded details. Also add a visually-hidden live region that announces "Rule 2 of 5 matched: send to dedicated" on step change.

zara: mobile: no hover, drag handles collapse into a three-dot menu with Move up / Move down / Pin. Pin keeps a rule at the top for testing. Is pinning a pattern we want?

maya: pinning could help make deterministic tests during sim. but we should cap pins to one per policy to avoid confusion. add tooltip: "Pin this rule to keep it at top during simulation".

chris: reordering: propose two parallel mechanisms — drag handles for power users, and explicit up/down buttons for discoverability and a11y. On drag start, show a placeholder gutter and announce position with aria-live.

sam: implementation note: using keyboard drag pattern (space to grab, up/down arrows to move, space to drop) is standard. we should also provide Move to Top/Bottom quick actions.

aleks: validation copy: current badge reads "Error". Replace with friendly actionable copy: "Needs condition — add a match to activate this rule". For warnings: "Potential conflict with rule 3: overlapping conditions". Keep severity tokens (error/warn/info) but show human text.

leo: also add inline help links from the validation bubble to the docs anchor (e.g., /docs/routing#conditions). screen readers should include the link text: "Learn how to write conditions".

zara: simulation timeline idea: small tick marks for each evaluation, tap a tick to jump. ticks get a tooltip: "Rule 4: matched (10ms)". helps with latency debugging in Dedicated runs.

chris: UI tokens: using brand-blue-600 for focus is fine, but for matched state use success-500 combined with an icon. avoid relying on green alone for colorblind users. add dashed underline as secondary indicator.

maya: test plan for the review: 1) demo compact playback with ghosting; 2) show drag + up/down + keyboard move; 3) show validation copy variants; 4) mobile menu for move/pin; 5) a11y checklist.

sam: i'll prepare a small Cypress + axe test matrix to validate keyboard flows and live region announcements. estimate spike: 2d.

aleks: i'll sketch the compact playback + tick timeline and include an alternate full-modal version for comparison.

chris: will add microcopy suggestions into Figma: three variants for error text (short/actionable/technical) so we can pick in review.

design-bot: Reminder: design-review scheduled 2026-04-02 18:00 UTC. Figma link expected 2026-04-02 16:30 UTC.

maya: perfect. please post Figma + list of acceptance criteria in the doc before the meeting. thanks all!
